# Setup
```{R}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
})

stem <- "/restricted/projectnb/pathoscope/work/aubrey/newMB_02_25_meta_benchmark"
fig_stem <-  file.path(stem, "results/figures")
```

# Read in all metrics

## `read_in_file()` 
```{R}
read_in_file <- function(this_csv) {
  # print(this_csv)
  in_file <- read.csv(this_csv)
  this_metric <- stringr::str_split_i(basename(this_csv), 
                                      "_", 1)
  
  this_profiler <- stringr::str_split_i(this_csv,
                       pattern = "profilers/", i = 2) |>
    stringr::str_split_i(pattern = "/", i = 1) |>
    stringr::str_to_sentence()
  
  if (this_metric == "RRMSE") {
    in_file <- in_file |>
      column_to_rownames("X")
  } else if (this_metric == "R2") {
    rownames(in_file) <- "R2"
  } else if (this_metric == "ROC") return(NULL)
  metric_rownames <- rownames(in_file)
  
  # additional run information
  addl_run_info <- basename(this_csv) |>
    stringr::str_split_i("sample_", 2) |>
    stringr::str_remove_all("_final_summary") |>
    stringr::str_remove_all(".csv") |>
    stringr::str_split("_") |>
    magrittr::extract2(1)

  out_df <- in_file |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("sample") |>
    mutate(sample = stringr::str_split_i(sample, "\\.", 2),
           sample = stringr::str_split_i(sample,
                                         pattern = "stool_", i = 2),
           across(where(is.numeric), function(x) round(x, 3))) |>
    separate("sample", c("num_species_present", "species_dominance_score"),
             sep = "_", convert = TRUE) |>
    mutate("total_bases" = addl_run_info[1],
           "error_status" = addl_run_info[2],
           "profiler" = this_profiler) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(metric_rownames),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "metric_val")
  return(out_df)
}
```

## Read in ROC files

```{R}
read_in_roc <- function(this_csv) {
  in_file <- read.csv(this_csv) |>
      column_to_rownames("X")
  metric_colnames <- colnames(in_file)
  this_metric <- stringr::str_split_i(basename(this_csv), 
                                      "_", 1)
  
  this_profiler <- stringr::str_split_i(this_csv,
                       pattern = "profilers/", i = 2) |>
    stringr::str_split_i(pattern = "/", i = 1) |>
    stringr::str_to_sentence()
  
  # additional run information
  addl_run_info <- basename(this_csv) |>
    stringr::str_split_i("sample_", 2) |>
    stringr::str_remove_all("_final_summary") |>
    stringr::str_remove_all(".csv") |>
    stringr::str_split("_") |>
    magrittr::extract2(1)

  out_df <- in_file |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("sample") |>
    mutate(sample = stringr::str_split_i(sample, "\\.", 2),
           sample = stringr::str_split_i(sample,
                                         pattern = "stool_", i = 2),
           across(where(is.numeric), function(x) round(x, 3))) |>
    separate("sample", c("num_species_present", "species_dominance_score"),
             sep = "_", convert = TRUE) |>
    mutate("total_bases" = addl_run_info[1],
           "error_status" = addl_run_info[2],
           "profiler" = this_profiler) #|>
    #pivot_longer(cols = all_of(metric_colnames),
    #           names_to = "metric", values_to = "metric_val")
  return(out_df)
}
```

## Loop through
```{R}
all_profilers <- c("PathoScope2", "Bracken", "MetaScope", "MetaScope_priors")
prof_stem <- file.path(stem, "profilers", all_profilers, "combined_files/updated_species_names/analysis_results")
all_files <- list.files(prof_stem, pattern = ".csv$", full.names = TRUE)
all_files_ROC <- list.files(prof_stem, pattern = "^ROC", full.names = TRUE)

files_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_files, read_in_file))
roc_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_files_ROC, read_in_roc))
```

# Visualizations

## Boxplots
```{R}
for (this_metric in unique(files_combined$metric)) {
  p <- files_combined |>
    filter(metric == this_metric) |>
    mutate("Species Dominance Score" = as.factor(species_dominance_score)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = `Species Dominance Score`, y = metric_val,
               color = `Species Dominance Score`,
               fill = `Species Dominance Score`)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(profiler~total_bases) +
    ylab(this_metric) +
    labs(title = paste("Boxplot of", this_metric)) +
    theme_classic()
  
  ggsave(file.path(fig_stem, paste0("boxplot_", this_metric, ".png")),
         p,
         units = "in", width = 7, height = 5)
  print(p)
}


```

## Boxplot - NRMSE - without 10mil
```{R}
this_metric <- "NRMSE"
p <- files_combined |>
  filter(metric == this_metric,
         total_bases != "10mil") |>
  mutate("Species Dominance Score" = as.factor(species_dominance_score)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Species Dominance Score`, y = metric_val,
             color = `Species Dominance Score`,
             fill = `Species Dominance Score`)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(profiler~total_bases) +
  ylab(this_metric) +
  labs(title = paste("Boxplot of", this_metric, " - 10 mil removed")) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave(file.path(fig_stem, paste0("boxplot_", this_metric, "_no10mil.png")),
       p,
       units = "in", width = 7, height = 5)
print(p)
```
      
## ROC Curves

```{R}
roc_combined |>

             color = as.factor(species_dominance_score),
             shape = total_bases))+
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Dominance Scenario") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(0, 2, 3),
                     name = "Sequencing Depth") +
  facet_grid(profiler~num_species_present) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
```
